defect_boundary.symbol_identity: A Kraken exchange symbol is verified inside the Kraken market universe but is not globally unique news identity. Equity tickers, ETF tickers, government acronyms, ordinary abbreviations, and unrelated crypto projects can use the same text.
defect_boundary.context_identity: Generic market or organizational words such as price, trading, gains, fall, support, investor, chain, and similar terms cannot by themselves disambiguate a common-word or acronym alias.
defect_boundary.current_rule_result: The current rule is both too permissive and too restrictive; ad-hoc alias blacklists would not repair the defect class.

frozen_remediation_tasks.requirement: Preserve the corrected full-Q2 source/run accounting as PASS evidence while recording CFA-S3-005 FAIL for the bounded review.
Treat default Kraken exchange symbols as unverified standalone news identity; zero collision inside Kraken is not sufficient semantic approval for news matching.
Treat generic market/context vocabulary as insufficient standalone disambiguation for common-word or acronym aliases.
Return to upstream alias-identity/corroboration design before modifying matching; do not repair this defect with row-specific or alias-specific blacklists.
Before any new full-Q2 scan, regression-test revised semantics against the observed false-positive and false-negative classes in this review.
Only after component/sample regressions pass may the exact full-Q2 matcher be rerun and CFA-S3-005 reviewed again.
